Privacy notice

How Vestra Accountants Ltd collects and uses personal information through this website.

Draft notice: this should be reviewed against your actual business systems, professional obligations, retention schedules and data-sharing arrangements before publication.

Who we are

Vestra Accountants Ltd, BEC50, Cambridge Road, Barking, Essex, IG11 8FG. Contact: info@vestraaccoutants.co.uk or 0208 798 2436.

Information we collect

We may collect your name, company name, email address, telephone number, enquiry details and any information you choose to provide. Our form-processing provider may process submission data on our behalf.

Why we use it

We use enquiry information to respond to you, assess whether we can provide services, take steps at your request before entering a contract, administer our relationship and meet legal or professional obligations.

Lawful bases

Depending on the circumstances, we may rely on steps taken before entering a contract, performance of a contract, compliance with legal obligations, legitimate interests, or consent.

Sharing

We may share information with service providers supporting our website, communications and business systems, and with regulators, professional advisers or authorities where required. We do not sell personal information.

Retention

Enquiry information is retained only as long as reasonably necessary for the enquiry, potential engagement, legal requirements and the establishment or defence of claims. Client records may be retained for longer periods under applicable legal and professional requirements.

Your rights

Depending on the circumstances, you may have rights of access, correction, erasure, restriction, objection and data portability, and the right to withdraw consent. You may also complain to the Information Commissioner's Office.

International processing

Some service providers may process information outside the United Kingdom. Where applicable, appropriate safeguards should be used.

Contact

Privacy enquiries may be sent to info@vestraaccoutants.co.uk.
